lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured 2D grid arrangement consisting of two parallel horizontal rows; the inferior row features three high-luminance circular clusters, with a matching row of three clusters aligned directly above them.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs, forming a matrix of nodes across the visible lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal feature at the dorsal-lateral transition zone, characterized by a distinct linear gradient with high luminance on the upper edge and a shadowed trough below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Discrete high-luminance blobs distributed within the dorsal fin boundary, including a notable triangular arrangement of three spots near the trailing posterior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent parasitic copepod attached to the posterior margin of the dorsal fin, exhibiting a brown cylindrical body with two elongated, thread-like posterior filaments.
